paragraphs.text:
Your shaking arm spoils your shot. The wind-walker springs 
at you, knocking the rifle far out of reach. Then, with a blood-
chilling shout, it attacks. You turn and flee.

Make a Hard CON roll: if you succeed, go to 336; if you fail, go 
to 337.
